mapper.select: /* LoginMapper.selectUserByUserCd */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.USER_CD AS userCd , A.USER_ID AS userId , A.USER_NM AS userNm , A.USER_PW AS userPw , A.AUTH_CD AS authCd , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(A.CMPNY_CD, "AUTH_LEVEL", A.AUTH_CD, NULL) AS authLevel , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , B.SITE_NO AS siteNo , B.SITE_NM AS siteNm , A.NODE_CD AS nodeCd , C.NODE_NM AS nodeNm , A.MBL_NO_ENC AS mblNoEnc , A.EMAIL_ENC AS emailEnc , A.PWD_LOCK_YN AS pwdLockYn , A.PWD_FAIL_CNT AS pwdFailCnt , A.PWD_LOCK_EXPIRE_DTIME AS pwdLockExpireDtime , A.PWD_CHG_DTIME AS pwdChgDtime , A.WITHDRAWAL_DATE AS withdrawalDate , A.LAST_LOGIN_DTIME AS lastLoginDtime , A.ACCOUNT_STATUS AS accountStatus , A.INSERT_NO AS insertNo , A.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate , A.UPDATE_NO AS updateNo , A.UPDATE_DATE AS updateDate FROM TB_USER A INNER JOIN TB_SITE B ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = B.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = B.SITE_CD ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SITE_NODE C ON ( A.CMPNY_CD = C.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = C.SITE_CD AND A.NODE_CD = C.NODE_CD ) WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.USER_CD = #{userCd}
mapper.update: /* LoginMapper.updateUserPwdFail */ UPDATE TB_USER SET PWD_FAIL_CNT = PWD_FAIL_CNT + 1, PWD_LOCK_YN = CASE WHEN PWD_FAIL_CNT + 1 >= #{pwdFailMaxCnt} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, PWD_LOCK_EXPIRE_DTIME = CASE WHEN PWD_FAIL_CNT + 1 >= #{pwdFailMaxCnt} THEN DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{lockDurationMinutes} MINUTE) ELSE NULL END, UPDATE_NO = 'SYSTEM', UPDATE_DATE = NOW() WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND USER_CD = #{userCd}
mapper.select: /* LoginMapper.selectRequiredTermsList */ SELECT A.SYST_VAL_D_CD AS termsId , A.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS termsNm , B.TERMS_VERSION AS termsVersion FROM TB_SYST_VAL_D A INNER JOIN TB_TERMS B ON ( A.SYST_VAL_D_CD = B.TERMS_ID AND B.REQUIRED_YN = 'Y' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' ) WHERE A.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS008' /* 이용약관 코드 조회 */

/* LoginMapper.selectUserTermsAgreementCheck */ SELECT A.TERMS_ID AS termsId , A.USER_TERMS_AGR_YN AS userTermsAgrYn FROM ( SELECT A.TERMS_ID , CASE WHEN A.TERMS_VERSION = B.TERMS_VERSION THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END USER_TERMS_AGR_YN FROM TB_TERMS A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_TERMS_USER_AGR_MGMT B ON ( A.TERMS_ID = B.TERMS_ID AND A.TERMS_VERSION = B.TERMS_VERSION AND B.USER_CD = #{userCd} ) WHERE 1=1 AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ) A WHERE A.USER_TERMS_AGR_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: /* LoginMapper.mergeAuthMenuInfo */ INSERT INTO TB_TERMS_USER_AGR_MGMT ( USER_ID , TERMS_ID , TERMS_VERSION , AGR_YN , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE ) SELECT #{userId} AS USER_ID , TERMS_ID , TERMS_VERSION , 'Y' , #{userId} AS INSERT_NO , NOW() AS INSERT_DATE FROM TB_TERMS WHERE 1=1 AND TERMS_ID = #{systValDCd}
mapper.insert: /* LoginMapper.upsertUserDevice */ INSERT INTO TB_USER_DEVICE ( DEVICE_UUID , USER_CD , DEVICE_TYPE , DEVICE_MODEL , OS_VERSION , APP_VERSION , LAST_LOGIN_DTIME , LAST_LOGIN_IP , DEL_YN , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE ) VALUES ( #{deviceUuid} , #{userCd} , IFNULL(#{deviceType}, 'UNKNOWN') , #{deviceModel} , #{osVersion} , #{appVersion} , NOW() , #{loginIp} , 'N' , #{insertNo} , NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE USER_CD = VALUES(USER_CD) , DEVICE_TYPE = VALUES(DEVICE_TYPE) , DEVICE_MODEL = VALUES(DEVICE_MODEL) , OS_VERSION = VALUES(OS_VERSION) , APP_VERSION = VALUES(APP_VERSION) , LAST_LOGIN_DTIME = VALUES(LAST_LOGIN_DTIME) , LAST_LOGIN_IP = VALUES(LAST_LOGIN_IP) , DEL_YN = 'N' , UPDATE_NO = #{insertNo} , UPDATE_DATE = NOW()
